description: Seven triangle or ramp low-frequency oscillators sharing one main rate, each with its own multiplier, shape and range

params.text: Switches between the RATE knob and the rate worked out from the SYNC input; with nothing patched to SYNC it holds all seven oscillators at their last values instead, and pressing again releases them
Sets how many pulses at the SYNC input make one cycle of the main rate, 1 to 24
Sets how many channels the PLY output carries, 1 to 7, taken from the first oscillators in order; at the 'c' end it sends a 1ms pulse on each main-rate cycle instead
Restarts every oscillator from the position its Ph knob sets
Sets where in its cycle that oscillator restarts after a reset, 0° to 360°
Chooses that oscillator's waveshape: ramp up, triangle or ramp down
Multiplies or divides that oscillator's rate against the main rate, from a twenty-first of it to twenty-one times it, with the centre position matching
Switches that oscillator's output from 0-10V to ±5V

inputs.text: Moves the main rate, ten hertz per volt at full attenuverter, added to the RATE knob
The pulses the main rate is worked out from, counted off against the PPC knob
A trigger here does what the SYNC button does
A trigger here restarts every oscillator from the position its Ph knob sets

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse each time a reset happens, whether from the button or the jack
The first oscillators gathered into one polyphonic cable, as many as the PLY knob sets, or a 1ms pulse per main-rate cycle with that knob at 'c'

menu: Wait full clock after reset — with sync on, a reset holds the cycles until a whole clock has passed before restarting them, which keeps a PPC above 1 lined up
Integer * — sets the seven xRate knobs to successive whole-number multiples of the main rate
Integer / — sets the seven xRate knobs to successive whole-number divisions of the main rate
Even * — sets the seven xRate knobs to even-numbered multiples of the main rate
Even / — sets the seven xRate knobs to even-numbered divisions of the main rate
Odd * — sets the seven xRate knobs to odd-numbered multiples of the main rate
Odd / — sets the seven xRate knobs to odd-numbered divisions of the main rate
Prime * — sets the seven xRate knobs to prime-numbered multiples of the main rate
Prime / — sets the seven xRate knobs to prime-numbered divisions of the main rate
Fibonacci * — sets the seven xRate knobs to Fibonacci multiples of the main rate
Fibonacci / — sets the seven xRate knobs to Fibonacci divisions of the main rate

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
